Services
Two things, done properly.
We've spent a decade building software for big companies. Local businesses get the same standard of work.
You see the real build from the start, and what we build is yours to keep.
Custom software
The client list is split across three phones, the schedule comes from a paper calendar and a gut feeling, and orders get tracked in a group text until someone loses one. If any of that sounds familiar, it's the kind of thing we fix.
We build one small, sturdy tool to replace whichever is costing you the most time, usually something you open in a browser on your phone or computer. We can stay on afterwards to keep it running and add to it.
Web design
Your customers are choosing where to eat tonight, booking a charter, or comparing venues, and your website is what they have to go on.
Ours read clearly on a phone and put the next step, whether that's calling, booking, or ordering, one tap away. They're also set up so Google can read them properly.
You can update the menu yourself in a few minutes, with no PDF to re-upload. Booking can run on your own site if you'd rather not send customers to a third-party app.
How a project runs
Discovery
We start by talking through what you need. Afterwards you get a written scope, short enough to read in one sitting.
Build
You get a working link at the start of the project. It opens the real build, so you can click through it as it takes shape and send feedback as you go.
Launch
Most projects so far have gone live within two weeks. We hand it over with an owner's manual and a bow, and you can stay with us afterwards or take everything we built to anyone you like.
Care
We offer ongoing care that keeps it secure and up to date. If you'd rather not, everything we built is still yours.
There's no charge until a contract is signed.
